items.title: Manny Albam interviewed by Monk Rowe, Tarrytown, New York, October 31, 1998
items.q: I figured Gene Orloff was going to be the concertmaster... I knew they would be there.

ctx.x: I was going to ask about that and we might as well talk about it now, it was Gene Orloff, wasn’t it?
I was curious as to how much you wrote for him and how much was improvised.
